name: schegent
description: Autonomously orchestrates the Claude Code CLI to drive the spec-driven development pipeline.

commands.title: Schegent: Resume Paused or Failed Workflow
Schegent: Re-detect Claude CLI prompt transport

schegent.cli.path.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary.

schegent.cli.inheritEnvironment.description: When enabled, Schegent backend CLI processes inherit the VS Code extension-host environment before Schegent-controlled variables are overlaid. Disable to spawn the backend with only Schegent-controlled variables.

schegent.cli.environmentMode.markdownDescription: Controls ambient environment forwarding to backend CLIs. `inherit` preserves the extension-host environment for compatibility; `minimal` forwards only Schegent-controlled variables; `allowlist` forwards required bootstrap variables plus the names in `schegent.cli.environmentAllowlist`. The legacy `schegent.cli.inheritEnvironment: false` always forces `minimal`.

schegent.cli.environmentAllowlist.markdownDescription: Environment variable **names** to forward when `schegent.cli.environmentMode` is `allowlist`. Values are read from the extension host at spawn time and are never stored in this setting. Required PATH/home/temp/locale/runtime bootstrap variables are included automatically.

schegent.backend.runner.description: Backend runner used to drive each phase invocation. `claude` (default) spawns the Claude CLI (`schegent.cli.path`). `codex` spawns the Codex CLI in non-interactive `exec --json` mode with a workspace-write sandbox. `agy` spawns the Agy CLI with `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--output-format stream-json`. The prompt is piped over stdin for all backends. Per-phase overrides can be set via `schegent.phases[*].runner`. See docs/operations/backends.md for the contract any backend must honor.

schegent.backend.probeTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time in seconds for backend availability and model-discovery probes. Timed-out probes are terminated and treated as unavailable.

schegent.codex.path.description: Path to the Codex CLI binary. Defaults to `codex` (resolved via PATH).

schegent.agy.path.description: Path to the Agy CLI binary. Defaults to `agy` (resolved via PATH).

schegent.loop.maxIterations.description: Maximum iterations for the Clarify and Analyze loop phases before force-advancing.

schegent.watchdog.pollIntervalMinutes.description: Credit watchdog poll interval in minutes.

schegent.invocation.timeoutSeconds.description: Per-phase CLI invocation timeout in seconds.

schegent.audit.rotation.sizeMB.description: Audit log rotation threshold in megabytes.

schegent.audit.rotation.maxAgeDays.description: Audit log rotation max age in days.

schegent.models.markdownDescription: Map of backend kinds to their custom model identifiers.

schegent.phases.markdownDescription: Portable custom Phase definitions. Resolution selects one complete valid row per id with workspace > user > built-in precedence; invalid rows remain visible for repair and fall back to the next valid source.

name.markdownDescription: Display name shown in sidebar tiles, audit logs, and the pipeline picker.

description.markdownDescription: Optional plain-text description shown in the Phase catalog.

version.markdownDescription: Positive definition version. Legacy rows without this field load as version 1.

instruction.markdownDescription: Phase-specific directive injected into the selected backend prompt.

skill.markdownDescription: Declarative Agent CLI skill reference. Schegent passes this value as prompt content and never loads it as extension code.

model.markdownDescription: Optional backend model id passed to the selected CLI for this phase only.

effort.markdownDescription: Optional reasoning effort level passed to the selected CLI for this phase only. Agy caps `xhigh` and `max` to `high`.

timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Optional per-phase timeout in seconds (1 to 3600).

loopable.markdownDescription: Deprecated compatibility field retained for existing phase settings. Loop behavior is controlled by retryCondition and phase capabilities.

retryCondition.markdownDescription: Optional retry-condition DSL expression. When set AND the phase invocation produces a well-formed audit-log block, the expression is evaluated against the audit-entry's `metrics` map (extracted from `<identifier>: <number>` lines inside the SCHEGENT AUDIT LOG block). A truthy result loops the phase; a falsy result advances. The DSL supports identifiers (`[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*`, case-sensitive), signed numeric literals, comparison operators (`>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `==`, `!=`), boolean combinators (`and` / `or` / `&&` / `||`), unary negation (`not` / `!`), and parentheses. Operator precedence (highest to lowest): `not`/`!` > comparisons > `and`/`&&` > `or`/`||`. Arithmetic, function calls, and member access are NOT supported. An invalid expression invalidates that source row, keeps it visible for repair, and lets the next valid source row become effective. Examples: `"open_questions > 0"`, `"unresolved_findings > 0 or open_questions > 0"`, `"not (confidence > 0.85)"`.

isRequired.markdownDescription: Whether terminal failure stops the workflow. Missing or true is required. An explicitly optional phase (`false`) still exhausts normal retry policy, records its failed/timed-out result, and then continues.

runner.markdownDescription: Optional backend override for this phase. When omitted, `schegent.backend.runner` is used.

schegent.pipelines.markdownDescription: Custom pipeline definitions. A pipeline is an ordered chain of phase ids. The id `speckit-new-feature` is reserved for the built-in pipeline.

name.markdownDescription: Display name shown in the QuickPick picker and the sidebar header.

phases.markdownDescription: Ordered list of phase ids. Each id must match a built-in phase id or a `schegent.phases[].id` you defined.

description.markdownDescription: Optional summary shown in the Pipeline Builder and the pipeline picker.

version.markdownDescription: Definition revision. Increment when you change the contract so runs record which revision they captured.

inputs.markdownDescription: Declared input ports supplied when a run starts.

portId.markdownDescription: Port identifier, unique among this pipeline's inputs.

type.markdownDescription: Port value type. `pipeline-output` marks a port fed by an earlier phase rather than at session start.

required.markdownDescription: Whether a value must be supplied before the run can start.

description.markdownDescription: Optional operator-facing help text for the port.

outputs.markdownDescription: Declared output ports produced by the pipeline.

portId.markdownDescription: Port identifier, unique among this pipeline's outputs.

description.markdownDescription: Optional operator-facing help text for the port.

bindings.markdownDescription: Wiring between declared ports and phase positions. `phaseIndex` addresses a position in `phases`, not a phase id, because a phase id may repeat.

kind.markdownDescription: `input` feeds a phase; `output` publishes from a phase.

phaseIndex.markdownDescription: Zero-based position in `phases` this binding addresses.

inputKey.markdownDescription: Phase-side slot the value is delivered to. Required when `kind` is `input`.

portId.markdownDescription: Declared output port written to. Required when `kind` is `output`.

outputKey.markdownDescription: Phase-side slot the value is read from. Required when `kind` is `output`.

source.markdownDescription: Where an `input` binding reads its value from.

phaseIndex.markdownDescription: Producing position. Required when `from` is `phase-output`, and must be strictly earlier than the consuming `phaseIndex`.

executionDefaults.markdownDescription: Pipeline-level execution defaults applied to phases that do not override them.

recommendedNext.markdownDescription: Pipeline ids suggested as a follow-up after this one completes.

schegent.workflows.markdownDescription: Custom workflow definitions. A workflow is an acyclic graph of pipeline nodes joined by typed connections. Ports are derived from the referenced pipelines and are never stored here.

name.markdownDescription: Display name shown in the Workflow Library and Builder.

description.markdownDescription: Optional summary shown in the Workflow Library.

version.markdownDescription: Definition revision. Increment when you change the graph so runs record which revision they captured.

nodes.markdownDescription: Graph nodes. Each node runs one pipeline; two nodes may reference the same pipeline and are distinguished by `nodeId`.

nodeId.markdownDescription: Node identifier, unique within this workflow. Connections and conditions address nodes by this id.

pipelineId.markdownDescription: Id of the pipeline this node runs. Must resolve in the effective pipeline catalog.

label.markdownDescription: Optional display label distinguishing two nodes that run the same pipeline.

connections.markdownDescription: Typed connections between node ports. Several outgoing connections on one node are mutually exclusive alternatives, never parallel branches.

from.markdownDescription: Source endpoint: an output port on an upstream node.

to.markdownDescription: Target endpoint: an input port on a downstream node. Two connections may not bind the same input port.

condition.markdownDescription: Structured guard on this connection. Conditions are data, never expression strings: there is nothing to compile or evaluate.

left.markdownDescription: Left operand. `node-output` reads a field of an ancestor node's output; `node-status` reads that node's terminal run status.

field.markdownDescription: Dotted field path within the referenced node's output. Required for `node-output`.

operator.markdownDescription: Closed comparison operator set. Adding a member is a contract change, not a configuration one.

right.markdownDescription: Literal, or a non-empty array of literals for `in`. Absent for `exists`. A `node-status` comparison accepts only `completed`, `failed`, or `canceled`.

priority.markdownDescription: Ascending evaluation order among a node's outgoing connections; authored order breaks ties.

isDefault.markdownDescription: Fallback branch, considered last. At most one per source node.

selection.markdownDescription: How to reduce a collection source to a single value for a single-valued target port.

startNodeIds.markdownDescription: Nodes an operator may start this workflow from. Every node must be reachable from at least one of them.

schegent.defaultPipelineId.markdownDescription: Pipeline id used when a feature is enqueued without an explicit selection. Defaults to the built-in `speckit-new-feature` pipeline.

schegent.retry.maxAttempts.markdownDescription: Maximum delayed-retry attempts per run before pausing the queue. When a phase encounters a transient error or rate limit, it schedules a delayed retry. After this many consecutive failures without a clean recovery, the run and queue are paused. Range: 1–5. Feature 056 reduced the advertised max from 20 to match the effective implementation cap (`DELAYED_RETRY_CAP = 5`).

schegent.queue.globalConcurrencyCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of workflow runs that may be in-flight across the whole workspace at the same time. Each queue still runs at most one Task, so this is the ceiling on how many queues may be busy at once. A value outside the range is refused, not clamped. Range: 1–20.

schegent.logging.verbose.markdownDescription: When enabled, every Claude CLI invocation is spawned with `--debug-file`, `--output-format stream-json`, and `--verbose` flags. CLI streams are captured under `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/sessions/<runId>/diagnostics/<pipelineId>/<phaseId>/iter-<N>/` (`debug.json`, `stream.jsonl`, `verbose.log`). Diagnostic files are **unredacted** and gitignored. Toggle off to return to standard headless mode. Toggling mid-run applies to the next phase invocation only — prior invocations are not re-captured. Setting changes are read at every phase invocation, so no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.rawTranscriptMode.markdownDescription: Raw transcript retention policy frozen when each run starts. `always` retains every unredacted transcript; `errors-only` stages it privately and retains it only for failed, canceled, or paused runs; `off` disables raw transcript capture. Structured audit evidence remains enabled.

schegent.logging.sessionRetentionMaxAgeD.markdownDescription: Maximum age in days for **unredacted** raw transcripts and verbose diagnostic trees. Complete inactive-run artifacts older than this are removed on activation and after terminal runs. The append-only structured audit log is never pruned by this setting.

schegent.logging.sessionRetentionMaxByte.markdownDescription: Total byte budget for **unredacted** raw transcripts and verbose diagnostic trees. Oldest complete inactive-run artifacts are removed first; the active run and structured audit log are never pruned.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.description: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.description: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Accepts an absolute path (POSIX or Windows) or a workspace-relative path. Relative paths containing `..` are rejected. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode 0644 on POSIX.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Accepts an absolute path (POSIX or Windows) or a workspace-relative path. Relative paths containing `..` are rejected. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode `0644` on POSIX.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum size in bytes of the active runtime log file before rotation. When the next write would push the file past this size, the current file is rotated to `<path>.1` and existing generations shift by one (`.1` → `.2`, ...). Range: 64 KiB–1 GiB. Default: 5 MiB. Setting changes are read on every log emit, so no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxGeneration.markdownDescription: Number of rotated runtime log generations to keep (`<path>.1` ... `<path>.N`). Older generations are deleted on the next rotation. Range: 0–20. Default: 3. Setting changes are read on every log emit.

schegent.fatalSignatures.markdownDescription: Operator-additive supplement to the code-resident Fatal Signature Registry. Each element is a verbatim substring; when present in CLI stdout or stderr, the active phase fails fast on the current invocation. Code-resident signatures are managed via PR review and cannot be removed or modified here. A malformed value falls back to `[]` without blocking extension activation.

schegent.claude.autoCompactPctOverride.markdownDescription: When set, the value is exported as `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` to the Claude Code CLI to override its auto-compaction threshold. Integer between 1 and 100 (percent). Leave unset to use the CLI default.

schegent.multiRoot.suppressWarning.markdownDescription: Suppress the one-shot multi-root workspace warning toast surfaced at activation. Feature 058 makes the first folder in the active `.code-workspace` the canonical Schegent workspace folder; `.schegent/` state is created there, and other folders are treated as ordinary VS Code roots. Set to `true` to hide the per-activation toast. See `repo/docs/concepts/workspace-lock.md`.

schegent.ui.confirmations.enable.markdownDescription: Show confirmation prompts for destructive UI actions (Clean All, Clear Done, Remove Item, Cancel Item, Pause/Resume, Retry Phase Now, Restart Canceled, Modify Task, Rerun History, Reset Workspace). Feature 063: when `true` (default), every destructive action opens a confirmation dialog with a per-action 'Don't ask again' checkbox; when `false`, prompts are globally disabled and destructive actions run immediately. Per-action suppression is recorded in workspace state and survives reloads. The Reset Workspace action remains unsuppressible regardless of this setting.

schegent.trust.allowCustomPhases.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 059). When `null` (default), the capability follows the workspace's Workspace Trust state. When `true`, saving non-default phase definitions is allowed even on an untrusted workspace _only if_ the workspace itself is trusted (the Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened). When `false`, saving non-default phase definitions is denied at the IPC layer and a `trust.capability-denied` audit event is recorded. The four-step resolution ladder is: workspace-trust ceiling → workspace-scope → user-scope → default-allow. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.

schegent.trust.allowCustomRetryCondition.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 059) gating non-default retry-condition DSL expressions on phase rows. When `null` (default), follows Workspace Trust. When `false`, any save that introduces a non-default `retryCondition` on any phase row is denied at the IPC layer; the row's default retry-condition is unaffected. The Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.

schegent.trust.allowPipelineOverrides.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 059) gating non-default entries in the pipeline catalog (`schegent.pipelines`). When `null` (default), follows Workspace Trust. When `false`, saving a non-default pipeline catalog is denied at the IPC layer. Reset-to-defaults is always allowed. The Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.

schegent.trust.allowWorkflowOverrides.markdownDescription: Per-capability trust scope (feature 083) gating non-default entries in the workflow catalog (`schegent.workflows`). A distinct capability from `schegent.trust.allowPipelineOverrides`: permitting pipeline-catalog edits does not thereby permit workflow-graph edits. When `null` (default), follows Workspace Trust. When `false`, saving a non-default workflow catalog is denied at the IPC layer. Reset-to-defaults is always allowed. The Workspace Trust ceiling is never widened. See `repo/docs/operations/trust-scopes.md`.
